name: Shen Zhen GLI Technology Limited
summary: GLI develops intelligent soft robotic hands and focuses on innovative robotics products. It has received expressions of interest in orders from companies in healthcare, automotive, logistics, retail and electronics. Its business covers industrial robots, medical rehabilitation robots and consumer service robots.
